results.question: 查询最近30天内是否有站点曾超警戒水位。
results.expected_sql:
SELECT b.stnm AS '测站名称',
       rv.WRZ AS '警戒水位(m)',
       ROUND(MAX(r.z), 2) AS '最高水位(m)',
       ROUND(MIN(r.z), 2) AS '最低水位(m)',
       COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(r.tm)) AS '超警天数'
FROM sl323.st_river_r r
JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON r.stcd = b.stcd
JOIN sl323.st_rvfcch_b rv ON r.stcd = rv.STCD
WHERE r.tm >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND r.z > rv.WRZ
  AND rv.WRZ IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY b.stnm, rv.WRZ
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(r.tm)) DESC, MAX(r.z) DESC;
actual_sqls:
SELECT DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(tm) FROM sl323.st_river_r), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS start_date,
       (SELECT MAX(tm) FROM sl323.st_river_r) AS end_date

SELECT DISTINCT b.stcd AS '站码',
       b.stnm AS '测站名称',
       rv.WRZ AS '警戒水位(m)',
       MAX(r.z) AS '期间最高水位(m)',
       ROUND(MAX(r.z) - rv.WRZ, 3) AS '超警戒幅度(m)',
       MAX(r.tm) AS '最高水位时间',
       CASE WHEN MAX(r.z) > rv.GRZ THEN '红色预警(超保证)'
            WHEN MAX(r.z) > rv.WRZ THEN '黄色预警(超警戒)'
            ELSE '正常' END AS '预警级别'
FROM sl323.st_river_r r
JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON r.stcd = b.stcd
JOIN sl323.st_rvfcch_b rv ON r.stcd = rv.STCD
WHERE r.tm >= %s AND r.tm < %s
  AND rv.WRZ IS NOT NULL
  AND r.z IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY b.stcd, b.stnm, rv.WRZ, rv.GRZ
HAVING MAX(r.z) > rv.WRZ
ORDER BY MAX(r.z) - rv.WRZ DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(tm) FROM sl323.st_river_r), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date,
       DATE_FORMAT((SELECT MAX(tm) FROM sl323.st_river_r), '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date

SELECT DISTINCT b.stcd,
       b.stnm,
       rv.WRZ,
       MAX(r.z),
       ROUND(MAX(r.z) - rv.WRZ, 3),
       MAX(r.tm),
       CASE WHEN MAX(r.z) > rv.GRZ THEN '红色预警(超保证)'
            WHEN MAX(r.z) > rv.WRZ THEN '黄色预警(超警戒)'
            ELSE '正常' END
FROM sl323.st_river_r r
JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON r.stcd = b.stcd
JOIN sl323.st_rvfcch_b rv ON r.stcd = rv.STCD
WHERE r.tm >= '{start_date}' AND r.tm < '{end_date}'
  AND rv.WRZ IS NOT NULL
  AND r.z IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY b.stcd, b.stnm, rv.WRZ, rv.GRZ
HAVING MAX(r.z) > rv.WRZ
ORDER BY MAX(r.z) - rv.WRZ DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(tm) FROM sl323.st_river_r), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date,
       DATE_FORMAT((SELECT MAX(tm) FROM sl323.st_river_r), '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(tm) FROM sl323.st_river_r), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date,
       DATE_FORMAT((SELECT MAX(tm) FROM sl323.st_river_r), '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date

SELECT b.stcd,
       b.stnm,
       rv.WRZ,
       MAX(r.z) AS max_z,
       ROUND(MAX(r.z) - rv.WRZ, 3) AS exceed_amount,
       MAX(r.tm) AS max_z_tm,
       CASE WHEN MAX(r.z) > rv.GRZ THEN '红色预警(超保证)'
            WHEN MAX(r.z) > rv.WRZ THEN '黄色预警(超警戒)'
            ELSE '正常' END AS warning_level
FROM sl323.st_river_r r
JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON r.stcd = b.stcd
JOIN sl323.st_rvfcch_b rv ON r.stcd = rv.STCD
WHERE r.tm >= '{start_date}' AND r.tm < '{end_date}'
  AND rv.WRZ IS NOT NULL
  AND r.z IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY b.stcd, b.stnm, rv.WRZ, rv.GRZ
HAVING MAX(r.z) > rv.WRZ
ORDER BY MAX(r.z) - rv.WRZ DESC
